effect_policy.ticks: Periodic effects tick at 1 s intervals after release; target must remain valid and within effect area. No tick at time zero. Missing a tick never creates an extra tick later.
effect_policy.placed_effects: One active instance per caster per ability; replacement expires the old instance without a damage or heal trigger.
effect_policy.stacking: Identical buffs, damage-over-time, traps, and area effects from one source do not stack; the stronger effect applies, with no lifetime refresh.
effect_policy.targeting: Bosses ignore taunt and displacement; explicit boss slow substitutions remain as authored.
effect_policy.visual_budget: Every finite trigger should consume a visible pip or pulse. Active area overlays disappear exactly at expiration; no VFX suggests an extra healing or damage tick.
